Definition: from G1364 and G5590; two-spirited, i.e. vacillating (in opinion or purpose):--double minded.
BiblicalUsage: Double-minded, a person of two souls, wavering in opinion and purpose, unstable in all his ways and told to purify his heart.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a divided heart cannot stand, and the cure James gives is to draw near to God with a single, undivided loyalty.
